newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA RABSI UNCHANGED IN STAGNANT STOCK MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA RABSI UNCHANGED IN STAGNANT STOCK MARKET.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Wednesday's 41.14 points as the local stock market was stagnant for a sixth day in a row, brokers said.

Razvitie Investment Fund's third issue were offered at 35 levs against par of 100 levs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) but there were no bidders. Biohimbank shares were also offered there at par of 1,000 but no bids were received.
Balkanbank shares were bid at 700 levs on the BSE, still below par of 1,700 but there were no shares on offer, traders said.
